selection_proxy.definition: Optimistic offline rank-sensitive proxy: each typed grapheme costs one selection; accept costs rank+1 among five slots; choose cheapest completion after >=2 graphemes, or type word fully. Excludes spaces, scan navigation/timing, errors and cognitive effort; not measured AAC switch savings.
